description: This Swift source file implements a screen recording service for macOS that captures display output and optional audio, managing recording sessions and handling video/audio data via AVFoundation and ScreenCaptureKit. It defines classes for managing the recording lifecycle, error handling, and output file creation.

classes.name: ScreenRecordService
classes.description: Main service class providing functionality to initiate and manage screen recording sessions with customizable parameters like screen index, duration, frame rate, and audio inclusion.

classes.name: StreamRecorder
classes.description: Helper class conforming to SCStreamOutput, managing the AVAssetWriter lifecycle, handling video and audio sample buffers, and finalizing the output file.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Asynchronously starts a screen recording session for a specified screen, duration, fps, and audio options, returning the output file path and audio presence status upon completion.

methods.name: stream(_:didStopWithError:)
methods.description: Handles errors when the screen capture stream stops unexpectedly.

methods.name: stream(_:didOutputSampleBuffer:of:)
methods.description: Processes incoming sample buffers (video or audio) from the capture stream.

methods.name: finish()
methods.description: Completes the recording and finalizes the output file asynchronously.
